design.purpose: packing for a house move next month (control: none: this person has no notable attention or organisation difficulties)

text: Dear Margaret, I am writing to update you on the move, which is now five weeks away. I booked the removal firm in March and they have confirmed the date in writing, so that part is settled. The books are finished: twelve boxes, each labelled by room and numbered on a master sheet I keep in the green folder. The kitchen I did last Sunday in about three hours, and I was pleased to find that two boxes of mugs and plates were enough, which is fewer than I had budgeted for. I am a little worried about the garage, because there is forty years of tools and paint in it and I have not yet decided what the new house has room for. I have asked Peter whether he wants the workbench. He has not replied. I also keep wondering whether the new boiler will pass inspection before we complete, and I confess I woke at four this morning thinking about it. The solicitor says the paperwork is on schedule, and the council tax and utility changes were sent off on Monday, a week earlier than I needed. I shall take the curtains down only on the final weekend. Please let me know if the 14th still suits you for lunch.
